name: networking-on-linkedin-pack
description: 31 skills for winning clients through the people you already know, in seven stages: write your networking brief, your fit criteria and the line a contact can repeat; map your own network from your own LinkedIn data export, by fit to the brief and by closeness, down to a shortlist you choose by hand; research each person from public sources with a source for every fact; pick a reason to write that is useful to them and prepare the points you write from; tend past clients with no-ask check-ins, after-action reviews and approved case studies; ask for one specific introduction and make the introduction easy to forward; and keep a weekly rhythm with a run of ten, a follow-up tracker, a private log and a monthly review. For consultants, advisers, fractional executives, founders and owners who sell their own expertise. Claude helps you see your own network and prepare each conversation: you choose every person, write every word and send every message yourself, and nothing is scraped, automated or sent for you.
